general.source_text: The MBA overview lists Executive MBA as an English part-time dual-degree MBA with EBS and Durham University.

The admissions section states the bachelor's and master's entry routes, professional experience thresholds, English CV, translated diploma/transcripts, English proof, motivation letter, and joint interview.

raw_evidence_sections.heading: Admission requirements
raw_evidence_sections.text: Applicants submit either bachelor's-route or master's-route evidence, plus English CV, diploma and transcripts in original language and English, English proof, and a motivation letter; eligible applicants are invited to an admission interview.

key_findings: The official EBS Business School overview lists eight English programme entries across bachelor, master, MBA, and Executive MBA levels.

EBS bachelor admission is holistic: online application, higher-education entrance qualification, English proof, knowledge/personality tests, and an interview; SAT, ACT, or Gaokao can replace the online assessment route for some international applicants.

The EBS MSc programmes share a common admissions pattern: at least 180 ECTS bachelor's degree, English proof at TOEFL 95 / IELTS 7 / Duolingo 125 or waiver, valid admissions test score, and selection interview.
Master in Finance differs slightly by accepting CFA Level 1 as admissions-test evidence, but not for the Semester Abroad Track.

The EBS MBA requires at least two years of postgraduate full-time work experience; the Executive MBA has separate bachelor's and master's entry routes with five-year or three-year experience thresholds.
known_gaps: The official application portal was not entered; only public official pages were used.
Exact component scores and test validity periods for EBS English tests were not found in the reviewed public page text.
German-only law and continuing-education programmes visible on German pages were not converted in this English official-site pass.
